rows: Numerous road safety campaigns targeting excessive speed and drink and drug driving, encouraging parents to model positive behaviour for future drivers, improving road safety for motorcyclists, and ongoing seasonal campaigns targeting fatigue and holiday road safety.

Various intrastate and interstate campaigns to promote Victoria as a tourist destination, including a major new campaign to promote Melbourne to interstate visitors. Other campaigns promoted tourism in regional Victoria and Melbourne’s schedule of major events in 2017–18.

Family Violence campaign ‘Save Lives, Save 000 For Emergencies’ ambulance campaign, Influenza, Fostering Connections and Heat Health/Extreme Heat Warnings campaigns.

Numerous campaigns, including the  ‘Getting back’ return-to-work and ‘Bad Days’ enforcement campaigns, and the launch of a campaign promoting awareness of mental and physical workplace safety. 2017–18 summer fire safety and awareness campaign, and the summer Play it Safe by the Water campaign.

Night Network – 24-hour weekend public transport, Know Your Bus, Auto Top Up, Safety You Can See, High Capacity Metro Trains, and myki commuter club campaigns.

heading: Top 10 Victorian Government advertisers by campaign expenditure 2024–25
rows: TAC undertakes significant road safety campaigns in conjunction with media partners across TV, radio, digital and targeted multicultural and sports media channels. Also includes a significant partnership with out-of-home (OOH) media suppliers across Victoria to reach drivers while on the road. Specific 2024–25 campaigns targeted dangerous driving behaviours such as speeding, distracted driving, and drink and drug driving, and motorcycle safety.

Local and interstate recruitment campaigns to attract teachers to the early childhood and primary and secondary school sectors. Campaigns also highlighted the Free Kinder and Kinder Tick programs, the School Savings Bonus, and the ‘Many Talents One VCE’ campaign, increasing awareness of changes to VCE vocational pathways.
Department of Justice and Community Safety

Included major seasonal campaigns to improve community understanding of fire and fire risk and increase water safety and reduce drowning incidents. Also undertook a recruitment campaign to attract applicants to careers with Corrections Victoria.

Various campaigns delivered by the Victorian Infrastructure Delivery Authority (VIDA), under the Victoria’s Big Build brand, informed the community about disruptions associated with major transport infrastructure projects such as the Metro Tunnel, Regional Rail Revival, Level Crossing Removal Project, North East Link Project and the West Gate Tunnel Project. Also included a new Myki ticketing campaign, and public transport safety campaigns on road worker safety and regional level crossings.

Major campaigns to support the Victorian tourism sector, including the major new ‘Victoria/Melbourne: Every Bit Different’ campaign, promoting Melbourne and regional Victoria to local and interstate audiences.

WorkSafe Victoria launched a major new campaign to prevent work-related violence, and undertook campaigns to improve safety in the agriculture industry, reduce gender-based violence and harassment in the workplace, and improve workplace safety for young workers.

Major campaigns to promote the range of urgent healthcare services available to Victorians and promote mental health and wellbeing services. Also undertook various public health and safety campaigns, including, public fertility care services, winter COVID/flu health prevention, and access to gambling support services.
Seasonal campaigns to promote visitation to Zoos Victoria’s various venues and Zoos memberships, and conservation efforts undertaken by Zoos Victoria.
Domestic and interstate campaigns to promote the Australian Motorcycle Grand Prix 2025 at Albert Park, and the 2024 and 2025 Australian Motorcycle Grand Prix events in Phillip Island.

Campaigns to promote Museums Victoria venues such as the Melbourne Museum, Scienceworks and the Immigration Museum, and exhibitions and events such as ‘LEGO® Star Wars™: The Exhibition’ and ‘Victoria, the T.Rex’.
scope: Consolidated campaign advertising expenditure via MAMS; examples are not separately costed

heading: Top 10 Victorian Government advertisers by campaign expenditure 2023–24
rows: TAC undertakes significant road safety campaigns in conjunction with media partners across TV, radio, digital and targeted multicultural and sports media channels. Also includes a significant partnership with out-of-home (OOH) media suppliers across Victoria to reach drivers while on the road. Specific 2023–24 campaigns targeted dangerous driving behaviours such as speeding, distracted driving, and drink and drug driving, and motorcycle safety.

Major campaigns to support the Victorian tourism sector, including the major new ‘Victoria/Melbourne: Every Bit Different’ campaign, promoting Melbourne and regional Victoria to local and interstate audiences.
Department of Justice and Community Safety

Included major seasonal campaigns to improve community understanding of fire and fire risk, including the Fire Danger Rating System, and increase water safety and reduce drowning incidents. Also undertook a recruitment campaign to attract applicants to careers in corrections and youth justice.

Various campaigns under the Victoria’s Big Build brand, informing the public about disruptions associated with major transport infrastructure projects, such as the Metro Tunnel, Regional Rail Revival, Level Crossing Removal Project, North East Link Project and the West Gate Tunnel Project. Also included a new Myki ticketing campaign, and public transport safety campaigns on driving with buses and pedestrian safety.
Victoria Police undertook Major campaigns to attract new recruits to Victoria Police and to promote the Police Assistance Line and the Online Reporting portal.

Local and interstate recruitment campaigns to attract teachers to the early childhood and primary and secondary school sectors. Campaigns also highlighted the Free Kinder and Kinder Tick programs, and the ‘Many Talents One VCE’ campaign, increasing awareness of changes to VCE vocational pathways.

WorkSafe Victoria undertook major campaigns to prevent work-related violence, improve safety in the agriculture industry, reduce gender-based violence and harassment in the workplace, and improve workplace safety for young workers.

Major campaigns to recruit mental health professionals to work in Victoria and encourage Victorians to contact 000 for emergencies only. Also undertook various public health and safety campaigns, including promoting mental health and wellbeing services, public fertility care services, winter COVID/flu health prevention, and prevention of mosquito-borne diseases.

Annual campaign promoting the range of exhibits and events at NGV in 2023–24, including Pierre Bonnard: Designed by India Mahdavi , Triennial 2023 exhibition, Melbourne Winter Masterpieces 2024: Pharaoh , and Africa Fashion .
Department of Families, Fairness and Housing
Campaigns included the ‘Jobs that Matter’ Community Services Sector workforce recruitment campaign and the ‘Go Where You’re Needed’ Child Protection Workforce Recruitment campaign.
